-- orders dispatched in range: does line gross sum match order_total_gross; line_count match
WITH ln AS (SELECT receipt_id, sum(gross_amount) g, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(ln.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN ln.c<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) count_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN ln.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nolines
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-15' AND DATE '2024-11-05' GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_gross_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS web_sales_net_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

-- control: rpt_daily_store_sales web net before returns vs my net, and test-line impact
WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
), m AS (
SELECT d.fiscal_period p, SUM(f.net_amount) n, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) test_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6) AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.p, m.n, (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period=m.p) rpt_net
FROM m ORDER BY 1
